main.description: One post on subatomic, reddit-but-atproto. A link post (url) or a self post (text), always addressed to a board (a freeform community tag, like a subreddit name). Written to the poster's own repo; src/index.ts's /api/submit-post reads it back off that repo to verify it before folding it into the shared feed at https://subatomic.bisks.net.

board.description: The community this post belongs to, lowercase alphanumeric plus dashes, e.g. "atproto" or "cooking".

url.description: Optional link this post points to. A post has a url or text, not both.

text.description: Optional self-post body. A post has a url or text, not both.

createdAt.description: When this was posted, as an ISO 8601 datetime.
